summary_en: 600,000 shares (6.2% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 block trade on 2026-06-26 at ¥728/share (previous close), total outlay ¥436.8M. Results to be announced after market close.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Self-Trading Outside Regular Hours (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-25, the board of IZAWA TOWEL CO., LTD. resolved to acquire up to 600,000 treasury shares (6.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) via a single ToSTNeT-3 block trade on 2026-06-26 at ¥728 per share (the previous day's closing price), for a maximum outlay of ¥436.8M. The block order will be placed at 08:45 JST and is valid only during that trading window; results will be announced immediately after market close. The company cited capital efficiency improvement and stronger EPS as strategic objectives, while the timing reflects a request from a major shareholder to sell holdings without disrupting market supply-demand dynamics.
